# FlashLock

> FlashLock is an Android beta that puts flashcard study before selected everyday apps, helping users build a study habit.

Official website: https://flashlock.app/
Reviewed: 2026-11-06

## Product facts

- Android beta available through the Google Play link on the official homepage.
- Users can study with their own flashcards and import Anki decks; consult the guides for current instructions.
- Accessibility and Usage Access support selected-app learning breaks on Android.
- The website demo is a preview, not the installed app, and does not save study progress.
- No iOS app is currently available. Website iOS email signups are closed; no launch date is promised.
- Study suggestions are not guarantees of academic outcomes. Features may change during beta.

## New study articles (published 16 November 2026)

- [Top Android apps for study and focus: five useful choices](https://flashlock.app/guides/top-android-study-focus-apps/): Choose an Android study or focus app by the job you need: flashcard breaks, scheduled review, focus timers, app-opening pauses or blocking.
- [How to study anatomy with active recall](https://flashlock.app/guides/anatomy-active-recall/): Build anatomy recall around structures, spatial relationships and checked explanations, with a practical session plan and better flashcard prompts.
- [How to learn physics formulas with flashcards and problems](https://flashlock.app/guides/physics-formula-flashcards/): Learn what a physics formula means, when it applies and how to check units; then practise choosing and using it in worked problems.

- [Krebs cycle: eight steps, energy yield and recall questions](https://flashlock.app/guides/krebs-cycle/): Enzymes, carbon counts, cycle-only yields, common mistakes and recall questions. Published 16 November 2026.
